description: Use this when the person needs new companies to sell to, for example when their pipeline is thin. Searches the web for real companies showing the problem the person's product solves right now (hiring, launches, funding, expansion) and links the page behind every piece of evidence. Uses the product saved on the account. Takes up to a couple of minutes. Only companies with sourced evidence are returned. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

companyName.description: Your company name. Defaults to the product saved on your account.

coreCapability.description: The single most important thing your product does — the core capability that makes customers buy

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

productDescription.description: What your product does and who it's for. Defaults to the product saved on your account.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

targetMarket.description: Target market segment (e.g., "Series A SaaS companies")

name: discover_prospects
title: Find likely buyers
